title: Quality Plant Manager, 1st Shift
text:
To thrive as a Plant Quality Manager, you are a strategic quality leader who is passionate about driving continuous improvement, developing high performing teams, and ensuring world class product and process quality. You will lead plant quality systems, champion quality initiatives, and partner with cross functional teams to build a culture of excellence, accountability, and operational success. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with exceptional leadership skills to help elevate quality performance across the organization!

In this role, you will oversee plant quality programs, analyze key quality metrics, identify improvement opportunities, and lead quality focused initiatives that support business objectives. You will collaborate closely with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, R&D, and Corporate Quality teams to resolve quality challenges, strengthen processes, and drive sustainable results. We value leaders who inspire teams, foster professional development, and proactively create solutions that enhance quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Together, we strive for continuous improvement, and we believe quality is everyone's responsibility.

**Here’s what we’re looking for:**

 

* High School Diploma required; Bachelor's degree preferred in Quality, Engineering, Management, or a related technical/scientific field.
* 5+ years of progressive experience in quality management, quality engineering, or manufacturing quality leadership, with a proven track record of leading plant-level quality systems, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and successfully managing cross-functional quality programs in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in batch chemical manufacturing and managing Quality Control (QC) laboratory operations, with a strong understanding of quality testing processes, laboratory compliance, and manufacturing quality standards.
* Experience using statistical analysis and problem-solving tools to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated leadership ability with experience coaching, developing, and managing high-performing teams.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to build effective partnerships across multiple functions.
* Experience managing budgets, resources, and quality performance metrics in a manufacturing environment.
* ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CQM) and/or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) certification preferred.

**Here’s what we offer you:**

 

* Accrue 15 paid days of vacation time off the first year plus sick days.
* Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
* 401(k) retirement plan with 4% match. Annual retirement profit sharing payments.
* Competitive health plans for individuals and families.
* Check out behr.com/careers to view a comprehensive list of our benefits and perks.
